# Ezekiel 10 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 10:8 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-there-appeared to-the-cherubim the-form-of a-hand-of a-human under their-wings. |
| LOGOS | The cherubim appeared to have the form of a human hand under their wings. |
| PNEUMA | I could see something that looked like human hands beneath the cherubim's wings. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 10:10 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-their-appearance — one likeness to-the-four-of-them, as-if the-wheel were in-the-midst-of the-wheel. |
| LOGOS | And as for their appearance, the four had the same likeness, as if a wheel were within a wheel. |
| PNEUMA | All four wheels looked identical, and each appeared to have a second wheel intersecting it at right angles. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 10:11 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | In-their-going, upon their-four sides they-would-go; they-did-not-turn in-their-going, for the-place where the-head would-face, after-it they-would-go; they-did-not-turn in-their-going. |
| LOGOS | When they went, they went in any of their four directions without turning as they went, but in whatever direction the front wheel faced, the others followed without turning as they went. |
| PNEUMA | The wheels could move in any of four directions without turning. Whichever direction the lead wheel faced, the others followed instantly. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 10:13 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | To-the-wheels — to-them it-was-called 'the-wheelwork' in-my-hearing. |
| LOGOS | As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing "the whirling wheels." |
| PNEUMA | I heard the wheels being called 'the whirling wheels.' |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 10:16 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-in-the-going-of the-cherubim, the-wheels went beside-them; and-in-the-cherubim lifting their-wings to-rise from-upon the-earth, the-wheels also did-not-turn from-beside-them. |
| LOGOS | And when the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them. And when the cherubim lifted their wings to mount up from the earth, the wheels did not turn from beside them. |
| PNEUMA | When the cherubim moved, the wheels moved with them. When they spread their wings to fly up from the ground, the wheels stayed right beside them. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 10:18 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-glory-of YHWH went-out from-upon the-threshold-of the-house, and-stood over the-cherubim. |
| LOGOS | Then the glory of the LORD went out from the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubim. |
| PNEUMA | Then the glory of the LORD moved away from the doorway of the Temple and hovered above the cherubim. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
